headline: Critics hail Grand Theft Auto VI as a masterpiece
summary: Critics have broadly praised Grand Theft Auto VI as a masterpiece, highlighting an extraordinarily detailed virtual world and new empathy for its two lead characters, alongside its trademark chaotic humor. One report notes the game's trailer attracted 90 million views within 24 hours. Coverage is uniformly positive, with no major disagreement among outlets about the game's quality.
